title: xAI-VNS: Burden-Constrained Policy-Layer Explainability for Simulated EEG-Guided Adaptive Vagus Nerve Stimulation
description: Executable complete-recording analysis accompanying the manuscript on simulated EEG-guided VNS authorization. Version v1.1.0 evaluates all 175 EDF recordings available for five CHB-MIT cases while keeping model fitting, calibration, and operating-point selection restricted to the model-development recordings. The release includes derived inputs, fitted models, predictions, policy/event outputs, tests, final manuscript figures, and LaTeX sources. Raw CHB-MIT EEG is not redistributed.
